title: How to Change or Correct Your BVN Name in Nigeria
excerpt: Correct a spelling error, surname, or name order on your BVN with the right supporting documents and a safe, traceable process.
keywords: how to change BVN name online

sections.content: You can request a correction when the name on your BVN is misspelled, in the wrong order, or no longer matches your legal name. The evidence depends on the type of change. A one-letter correction is different from adopting a new surname after marriage or replacing a substantially different name.

CBN guidance allows minor name corrections with valid identification and recognises name changes supported by legal documents. Banks must also keep a consistent BVN name across a customer's accounts. The safest approach is to establish the correct legal name first, then update the central BVN record and ask each bank to refresh its local profile.
Identify the Type of BVN Name Change

rows: Valid ID showing the correct spelling
Marriage certificate and other required legal documents
Affidavit, publication, ID, and any extra bank requirement
Central BVN is correct but one account differs
Fresh BVN verification and bank profile-update form

sections.content: Documents Commonly Used for BVN Name Correction

items: A valid government ID showing the correct name.
Your NIN slip when the BVN should be aligned with the NIN record.
A marriage certificate for a marriage-related surname change.
A sworn affidavit stating the former and correct names when required.
A newspaper publication for a legal name change when required.
The bank's completed BVN or customer-information update form.

sections.content: Ask the receiving institution for its exact checklist. Do not pay for documents you do not need, but do not omit evidence that explains a material change. Every document should use the same final spelling and name order.

sections.content: What If Your BVN Name Does Not Match Your NIN?

CBN guidance requires financial institutions to retrieve BVN or NIN details from the authoritative databases during onboarding. A mismatch can stop the process. Compare both records with your strongest legal documents and correct the record that is actually wrong. Our BVN and NIN mismatch guide explains that decision in more detail.
How Long Does BVN Change of Name Take?

A CBN circular set five working days as the resolution timeline for BVN issues after all required documents are submitted. A complex change can take longer if evidence is incomplete or if a bank needs additional review. After central approval, a separate bank profile may still need to be refreshed. See our BVN update timeline guide for the stages.

items: Can I correct one misspelled letter? Yes. A minor error can be supported with valid identification showing the intended spelling.
Can I change to a completely different name? A substantial change receives more scrutiny and requires legal evidence explaining the difference. Ask the receiving institution for its checklist.
Does changing my BVN name update every account automatically? The central result may change first. Each bank may still need to refresh its local customer profile.
What if my NIN contains the wrong name too? Compare both records with your legal evidence and correct the inaccurate source record. Do not make two records consistently wrong.
Can I edit the BVN slip instead? No. Editing a PDF does not change the central record and can create a false identity document.
